description: Free and open-source Windows PDF editor with a self-extracting portable launcher, OCR, annotation, text editing, redaction, signing, forms, comparison and conversion.
notes: The official portable launcher extracts its runtime to %LOCALAPPDATA%\KillerPDF\Portable while running and removes it after exit.
User settings and data are persisted in KillerPDF-Data. Prefer 'scoop update killerpdf' to keep the installed version synchronized with the bucket.
